_comment: Copy to posting-gate.json. Anything other than --privacy private is refused unless the channel below says allowed:true. A missing, unreadable or malformed file means private-only.

youtube.why: Uploads from an unaudited Cloud project are locked to private anyway. Open this only after the YouTube API compliance audit has passed and you intend to publish.

tiktok.why: Direct posts stay SELF_ONLY until this is true. Open only after the TikTok Content Posting API audit has passed and you intend to publish.
